title: questions.json of a piece
description: Questions an agent asked in one piece of a conductor run (<run>/<item>/questions.json) and the resolutions given to them; written by the conductor and by orch conduct answer under questions.lock.

questions.description: Questions in the order they were asked.

value.description: A JSON value given as an answer, a default or an assumption.

by.description: Who answered: a user name, policy, the advisor, the panel or decision:<D#> (an accepted decision of the plan).

authority.description: Authority snapshot of a policy or advisor answer.

binding.description: The input the question was asked on.

input_digest.description: Digest of the whole execution-input (legacy binding).

input_part_digest.description: Digest of the required part of the execution-input (P3.7).

id.description: Id of the question, stable across rounds.

revision.description: Revision; it goes up when the input it was asked on changed.

answer_schema.description: JSON Schema of a free answer; applied when it loads in the closed profile.

answer_schema_ignored.description: Why answer_schema was not applied to the answer (outside the closed profile).

blocking.description: The work cannot go on without the answer.

status.description: open, answered, applied, assumed, denied or stale.

asked_at.description: UTC time the question was asked.

applied_at.description: UTC time the answer was handed to the executor.

question_key.description: qk- and 16 hex characters of the digest of the meaning of the question (item, kind, text, options, answer schema); set when an accepted decision answered it.

question_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical meaning of the question.

auto_answered.description: The policy or the advisor answered it.

advice.description: Summary of the advice behind the question or its answer (file, recommendation, confidence, held).
